title: an object with an async destroy cannot be owned in synchronous code
purpose: The construct is invalid and must not complete.

failure.justification: An object with an async destroy can be owned only where the end of its scope can be awaited; a synchronous main cannot.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0; async destroy by #154
provenance.expected_basis: Conn has an async destroy; constructing it in a synchronous main is a compile-time error.
